'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe G LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe G]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Username:''' jigga
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
